repos_data.description: Free, open-source macOS cleaner. CleanMyMac alternative with zero telemetry. Native SwiftUI, scheduled auto-cleaning, Xcode/Homebrew/system cache cleanup. MIT licensed.
Safety-first disk cleaner and space analyzer for macOS, Windows and Linux, with duplicate cleanup, app uninstall, startup management, system optimization, and maintenance.
📦 A macOS utility to seamlessly migrate applications to external storage and reclaim local disk space.【一款 macOS 工具，无缝迁移应用到外部存储并自动建立链接，释放宝贵的本地空间】
Mac Sai: the open-source Mac cleaner, optimizer, and malware scanner. A free, Apple-notarized alternative to CleanMyMac, built with Swift 6 and SwiftUI.
Transparent macOS disk cleaner — groups files by app, moves to Trash (never permanent). SwiftUI + Liquid Glass, built for macOS Tahoe.

Free, open-source CleanMyMac alternative for macOS. Preview disk cleanup by path and size, inspect memory by app, and quit idle apps after review. Menu bar app, CLI, Homebrew. No account or telemetry.
Free, open-source Mac cleaner: a native SwiftUI app for Mole. Clean caches, uninstall apps and their leftovers, map your disk, monitor your Mac. A CleanMyMac alternative.
Free, open-source Mac app that finds what Docker, node_modules, old IDEs and duplicate files leave behind.

Free, open-source CleanMyMac alternative for macOS. Native SwiftUI disk cleaner for app caches, node_modules, Xcode DerivedData, Docker and AI tool caches (Codex, Claude Code, Ollama) - nothing is ever really deleted: it all goes to the Trash and stays undoable. No telemetry, no subscription.
Menu bar app that finds and frees the disk space dev build artifacts and caches hog on macOS. Free, open source, notarized, zero telemetry.
Free, open source Mac menu bar app for memory and disk. See what uses your RAM, keep a week of history, pause idle apps, find large files, and uninstall cleanly. No network access.
Free native macOS disk analyzer with a folder tree, treemap, file categories, safety guidance, and fast cleanup.

Free, open-source macOS disk cleaner and disk space analyzer for developers — a CleanMyMac/DaisyDisk alternative. Clean Xcode, Docker, simulators, node_modules and 40+ caches from the menu bar, and see every gigabyte in a 2D/3D treemap.
